Heeralal vs State Of U.P. on 15 December, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:237606
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 53859 of 2023

Applicant :- Heeralal
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Raj Pandey,Shubham Pandey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ram Raj Pandey,, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Imran Khan, learned Aga
for the State-respondent.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
633 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B, 201 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Bisrakh, District Gautam Budh Nagar, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his family members and according to the FIR, marriage of the brother of the applicant was performed with the daughter of the informant about 2 years before and after marriage, applicant and his family members tortured her for Rs.
Three lacs and due to non fulfilment of the demand of dowry on 4.8.2023 they have committed her murder by administering poison.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is the devar of the deceased and on the basis of false allegations he has been made accused in the present matter and it appears that his Heeralal vs State Of U.P. on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75983895/
1 bhabhi i.e. the deceased had committed suicide by consuming poisonous substance.
5. He further submitted that applicant actually resides in District-Badaun and he was not aware about the dispute arose between husband and wife and the fact that he is the resident of District-Badaun has specifically been averred in para-9 to the affidavit.
6.

entities.text: Heeralal vs State Of U.P. on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submitted that bail application of mother in law of the deceased has been allowed by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 2.11.2023 and copy of the bail application has been annexed as annure-6 to the affidavit and only being devar of the deceased, he has been made accused in the present matter and case of applicant is even on better footing than the case of mother in law.

7. He further submitted that applicant is having no criminal history and he is in jail in the present matter since 5.6.2023 i.e. for last more than six months.
8.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the fact that bail application of mother in law has already been allowed by the co-ordinate bench of this Court and applicant is devar of the deceased and there is no specific allegation has been made against the applicant.
9.
He further could not dispute that it is a case in which deceased died due to consumption of some poisonous substance.
10. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. Considering the fact that applicant is devar of the deceased and no specific allegation has been levelled against the applicant and even as per prosecution deceased died due to consumption of some poisonous substance and bail application of mother in law has been allowed by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court and case of applicant is even on better footing than the case of mother in law, in my view, applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
12.
Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

13. Let the applicant-Heeralal, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.

Heeralal vs State Of U.P. on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75983895/
2 (iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
14. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

15. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
